definitions.explanation: Indicates the number of floors in a building.

examples.japanese: {一戸建|いっこだ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いたい→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I want to buy a detached house.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五階建|ごかいだ}て⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{二階建|にかいだ}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in a two-story house.

notes:
〜{建|だ}て is a suffix indicating the number of floors or type of building structure.

PRONUNCIATION:
Usually read as {だて}, sometimes {たて}.

COMMON USES (number of floors):
- {二階建|にかいだ}て: two-story
- {三階建|さんがいだ}て: three-story
- {五階建|ごかいだ}て: five-story
- {高層建|こうそうだ}て: high-rise
- {平屋建|ひらやだ}て: single-story

BUILDING TYPES:
- {一戸建|いっこだ}て: detached house
- {木造建|もくぞうだ}て: wooden building
- {鉄骨建|てっこつだ}て: steel-frame building

GRAMMAR:
- Used as noun modifier: {二階建|にかいだ}ての{家|いえ} (two-story house)
- Used predicatively: この{建物|たてもの}は{五階建|ごかいだ}てだ

RELATED VERB: {建|た}てる (to build).
